splitNote: Brackettop.fcstd shipped 11 disconnected shells: shell 0 (7042 tris) was the plate body, shell 1 (896 tris) was a redundant duplicate deck on the back half, shells 2-7 (6x 92 tris) were hex bolt heads, shells 8-10 (3x 20 tris) were bolt shafts protruding below. Hardware was modeled into the source FreeCAD doc but never fused. Kept shell 0 only via tools/split_glb_shells.py. Note: shell 0 still contains 4 small integral side tabs (1 left, 3 right) connected to the main body in the source mesh. Removing them requires authored mesh surgery in Blender/FreeCAD; an automated slice at |x|=26mm cut into the main plate's side walls and was reverted.
